notes.title: UPDATE 1.1

[p]Hi everyone,

Hi everyone,

In this update, we have added a first version of clans.
Players can create their own clans by paying 250 Diamonds.
Clans have a ranking system, rules, and permissions so that you can better manage your members and decide who has the minimum requirements to join or not.
Clans also offer a progression system through daily donations from each member. Donations can increase the clan's level, unlocking permanent benefits. In addition, each donation grants a certain amount of Silver: a new currency available only within clans.

In future updates, we will implement the clan shop, in this way players will be able to spend their Silver to purchase unique rewards.
We have also added a new chat channel dedicated exclusively to the clan, so players can exchange messages within the clan.

Clan development is just beginning, and in the future we will add new features such as clan wars, rankings, new benefits, and much more. Stay tuned to our Discord channel to keep up to date!
In the next updates, we plan to expand the premium system with new features and offers, so stay tuned for new opportunities you won't want to miss!

[i]PS: We are still working on completely redesigning all battlegrounds, and are currently about halfway through. We would have liked to release the new battlegrounds with this update, but the amount of work involved is greater than expected, so we ask for your patience for a few more months. We are committed to providing the best possible quality for our players.

notes.title: v0.8.2.beta
notes.content:
Hi everyone, in this update we have made an important change to the blessing system.

We have found that active blessings now provide bonuses globally regardless of the deck being used. This leads to constant modification or adaptation of decks to blessings, forcing the player to play the same way regardless of the deck used.

To address this issue, we have created a preset system where players can create/edit blessing configurations up to a maximum of 10 presets (3 for free and 7 premium, unlockable at a cost of 250 diamonds each).

Once the player has configured 1 or more blessing configurations to their liking, these can be associated with decks in the deck editor menu. In this way, the player can customize the deck based on the blessings (if they want to use them).

The blessings will now be linked to the deck, and you can create decks with a specific blessing configuration.

However, linking blessings to decks is optional. You can play decks without blessings if you wish, and some single-player game modes will adapt to your deck without blessings.

Configurations cannot be removed, but you can edit them following the previous reset and diamond cost logic, with the only exception being that a reset on a configuration will only apply to that configuration.

We strongly believe that the blessing system adds further strategic depth to the game, and with the introduction of this configuration system, it will be even more fun to play with active blessings.

PS: Decks already saved in certain modes such as Infinity Tower and challenges will not have blessings, but they will be available in the decks to use in future runs (we apologize for the inconvenience, but we cannot determine which blessings the deck might have once it is selected with the new system)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.7.0.beta
notes.content:
Hi everyone, in this update we have [b]change a bit the gameplay system[/b] and introduced a new premium singleplayer mode.

After careful consideration and evaluation of the game mechanics, we decided to make some changes to the basic gameplay.

In terms of graphics, we changed the combat layout by centering elements such as heroes and cards in the middle of the battlefield.

In terms of mechanics, we changed [b]2 fundamental aspects[/b] of the combat system:
[olist]
[*] When a creature attacks another creature, the attacking creature also takes damage from the defending creature. Basically, now creatures mutually exchange damage based on their attack value
[*] The order of attack has remained the same: from left to right. However, the selection of the target has been modified. The graphical centering of the creatures has created two situations: one in which two creatures are face to face and one in which a creature can be flanked by two other creatures. In the first case the attack mechanics remain unchanged, in the second case the creature on the left will be chosen first, and if it cannot be targeted, the one on the right. Basically, the creature will attack the creature in front of it, if present, or first the one on the left or the one on the right
[/olist]

We realize that the changes made have a considerable impact on the game and in particular on metabuilding. These changes were mainly dictated by the fact that we wanted to “align” ourselves with what the market, or rather, the players are used to “playing” in the world of TCGs. We truly believe that these changes will bring benefits in the medium-long term in terms of playability and enjoyment. The semi-automatic battle system has remained almost unchanged, as we consider it the soul of this game.

Clearly we had to reevaluate some abilities such as Guard and Taunt to make them compatible with the new system adopted.

We will monitor the situation confident that these changes will bring a new way of playing that is more strategic and fun.

Oh, and let's not forget the “bonus” of this update, a new premium singleplayer mode: [b]The Dark Maze[/b].

In this new mode you'll have to face 5 sectors of the Maze, each one made up of 20 paths, for a total of 100 paths to explore. You will start by choosing one of the 3 decks of 30 cards provided by the Maze. Each path consists of 3 choices: fight, add/remove a card to your deck, improve 3 random cards in your deck, choose 1 of the 3 proposed blessings or open a chest.Each choice, however trivial, must be considered carefully, because the further you go into the Maze, the more difficult it will become, and since you can't go back, you'll have to be very careful about what you choose

notes.title: v0.1.5.beta
notes.content:
Hi everyone, 

During this year's developments, we have been thinking a lot about the in-app purchase system. We promised that we would not include PTW systems, and we believe that this choice we have made is the right one.
However, the aesthetic component alone and some premium features have not been successful enough, and the risk is that we will not be able to afford the costs of maintaining the services online.

Therefore, we thought of adding the option to purchase resources (gems/essence) with diamonds. 
Even with the addition of this feature we feel that the game does not have PTW elements, as even by spending money, there is no certainty of advantage in matches.

The ability to purchase resources with diamonds is just a way to accelerate one's game progress by unlocking and leveling cards more quickly. 
However, the strategic component during matches remains and will remain unchanged, so victory, or defeat, will always and exclusively depend on the player's skill, regardless of one's cards in possession.

However, this system will remain experimental and we will monitor the sitation, in case we will over time adjust it to make it fairer.
In ARC we want to maintain the disparity between those who play by paying and those who do not only on the aesthetic/ progress level.

Happy new year to all!

[h3]New:[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added new premium shop section: buy resources (essence/gems) with diamonds
[*] Added first implementation of VIP system. From now you can gain VIP points each time you spend diamonds (for each 50 diamonds spent you gain 1 VIP Points, minimum 50 diamonds to get 1 points). At the moment the UI part and the benefits for this feature are not yet available, however when it is fully released you will be able to enjoy the benefits of VIP levels with the points you have already accumulated.

notes.title: ARC TCG BETA OUT NOW!

After about 9 months of development on the alpha version we are pleased to announce that the game, with this update, has entered the [b]beta phase[/b].

With the introduction of the beta version the frequency of updates will be reduced compared to how it was in the alpha.
Specifically, we will go from about 2/3 updates per week to 1 every 2/3 weeks (or at least 1 per month).

notes.title: Multiplayer League - Competitive
notes.content:
Hi everyone.

This update ends the most important developments on the game modes.

Although it came at the last, with the introduction of the Multiplayer League mode we have achieved the goal we set at the beginning of EA:
[b]To release a game with a strong competitive multiplayer component[/b].

As far as the game modes are concerned, we can consider that ARC has now reached enough maturity, offering everyone different choices for both the singleplayer and multiplayer parts.

In addition to all this we are also working on an experimental system on card/hero animations trying to add a more appealing feeling to the aesthetics of the game.
Clearly the work of replacing all the animations costs a lot of time so we will gradually release the new animations over the course of the various updates.

[b]What does the future hold for us?[/b]
We have now reached the end of the 2024 roadmap, and beyond the achievements we are happy and satisfied with the work so far and the effort we have put into meeting the promised timeline.
The 2025 roadmap will be available on our Discord server later this year where we will announce the new developments that will take place in the new year.
The year 2025 will be a less intensive year of developments than the year 2024, as we would mostly like to focus on the marketing part that has not been started yet, and we will try to increase our fanbase to offer players a more responsive matchmaking

We would like to remind everyone that we listen to community feedback every day in order to improve the game, and if you also want to give your small contribution join us on our Discord server: https://discord.gg/dQS2dmP5

On this point we are quite convinced and would like to maintain a gameplay model where player skill is rewarded and not the amount of money spent to progress and/or win.

We have also worked hard to increase the security level of the game and make life harder for cheaters.
We will definitely continue to improve and monitor this aspect while trying to disincentivize those players who play unfairly as much as possible.

In addition we have started a [b]first game balancing[/b]. Other balancing will happen progressively as new updates are released (If you would like to contribute to this process you can follow our [b]Discord[/b] channel and give your opinion)

[b]New[/b]

[list]
[*] Added Tab keyboard key movement through input on Login/Password Recovery/Registration page
[*] Added card/hero levels preview in details window. You can move through level also with mouse wheel (scroll up/down) and middle mouse button click to return on current level

[/list]

[b]Improvements[/b]

[list]
[*] Improved online services
[*] Improved AI deckbuilding
[*] Improved AI behaviour (now only for hero, next time we'll improve also with card behavior)
[*] Improved graphics profiles settings
[*] Improved activity reward logic
[/list]

[b]Changes[/b]

[list]
[*] Update "new version" message text to clarify better that time updates through Steam is managed by Steam and not by me. (It's enough restart Steam sometimes to see an update)
[*] Changed buff/debuff health behavior. Now when an ability or else is going to modify health, it change also current health and not only max health (like attack buff/debuff)
[*] Changed cards visibility inside Laboratory Dismantle section. Now you can see all cards to dismantle (-1 for normal, -X for default, where X is the minimum amount of start copy card). Example: Have you 4 copy of card X? In dismantle now you can see only 3 copy of card X (if X is normal, if is default value is driven by Start Copy property). In less word: at least (1 for normal, X for default) card(s) is always preserved and cannot be dismantle. Default cards are cards present in default deck (You cannot dismantle minimum amount of default card in order to prevent a situation where you are not able to build any deck)
[*] When game is not able to communicate with server (for any reason) now you are forced to land on Login page showing an error message
[/list]
